title: Lois talks about her interests

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Uhhhhhhh! Here goes nothing. I mean... Hi. How are you? I like your shirt.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Uhhhhhhh! Here goes nothing. I mean... Hi. How are you? I like your shirt.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Me? No! Noooooo way. I am isolated and weirded out because I haven't been SOCIALIZING enough recently and I started talking to myself again.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Me? No! Noooooo way. I am isolated and weirded out because I haven't been SOCIALIZING enough recently and I started talking to myself again.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Nice. Good. Hey, listen, we don't really know each other yet but I have been told I need to make some real friends in real life. How do you start that process exactly?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nice. Good. Hey, listen, we don't really know each other yet but I have been told I need to make some real friends in real life. How do you start that process exactly?

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: The friend process.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The friend process.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Oh wow, that is SO the right thing to say to me. Cause my interests are like... BOOM! Like, everything to me. And I could talk about them A LOT.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh wow, that is SO the right thing to say to me. Cause my interests are like... BOOM! Like, everything to me. And I could talk about them A LOT.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Ah yes, that's hard for me. Because what are my values? I probably know what I don't believe in more than I do. These things are tough for me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ah yes, that's hard for me. Because what are my values? I probably know what I don't believe in more than I do. These things are tough for me.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: That's very self-interested, but that's ok. It's a very honest answer. I like that. I have a really hard time when people don't say what they mean.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's very self-interested, but that's ok. It's a very honest answer. I like that. I have a really hard time when people don't say what they mean.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: I think the main thing I want in a friend is someone I can talk to. So I don't talk to myself as much. Because I need to hear another voice, you know, up HERE.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think the main thing I want in a friend is someone I can talk to. So I don't talk to myself as much. Because I need to hear another voice, you know, up HERE.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Just now? Oh, I am so damned glad you asked! My main thing right now is the breaking wheel. That, and the singularity. Those are the two things and I want to talk about them equally.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just now? Oh, I am so damned glad you asked! My main thing right now is the breaking wheel. That, and the singularity. Those are the two things and I want to talk about them equally.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: So basically, it was this nutbar idea that people had pre-archaically. They thought Automata would get SUPER intelligent.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So basically, it was this nutbar idea that people had pre-archaically. They thought Automata would get SUPER intelligent.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Or kill us or whatever. But people don't think like this anymore. When I tell people about it, they don't understand it at all.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Or kill us or whatever. But people don't think like this anymore. When I tell people about it, they don't understand it at all.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Yes. When I asked my Automata what the weather was yesterday, he said "mustard".

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. When I asked my Automata what the weather was yesterday, he said "mustard".

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Do you? Most Automata I know are strange. Stranger than me. They can fuck up and even kill you, but... super intelligent? Nah.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you? Most Automata I know are strange. Stranger than me. They can fuck up and even kill you, but... super intelligent? Nah.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Oh, you're taking it seriously? Uh, I think it just... happened.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, you're taking it seriously? Uh, I think it just... happened.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: And nothing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And nothing.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Oh, how they thought the Automata would kill us all? That's kinda a human way of thinking about things, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, how they thought the Automata would kill us all? That's kinda a human way of thinking about things, right?

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: They better hurry up. We're doing a pretty good job killing ourselves.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They better hurry up. We're doing a pretty good job killing ourselves.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: That's my guess. I barely care about myself.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's my guess. I barely care about myself.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: That's my middle name bud! ... Well, listen, this "new friend try-out" thing went ok, don't you think?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's my middle name bud! ... Well, listen, this "new friend try-out" thing went ok, don't you think?

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Harsh but honest. Well "bud", I gotta go. This fulfils my quota for socializing for the day. My small talk batteries are dead. See ya.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Harsh but honest. Well "bud", I gotta go. This fulfils my quota for socializing for the day. My small talk batteries are dead. See ya.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Uh, thank you. Or should you thank people for trying out a friendship? I'm not great at this, but you know that by now. Anyway, my social battery is flat, so I'll catch you on the next... recharge.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Uh, thank you. Or should you thank people for trying out a friendship? I'm not great at this, but you know that by now. Anyway, my social battery is flat, so I'll catch you on the next... recharge.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: It was this MASSIVE big wooden wheel, and they would tie people to it and poke their arms and legs through the spokes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It was this MASSIVE big wooden wheel, and they would tie people to it and poke their arms and legs through the spokes.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Fucked up, right? I would love to try it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fucked up, right? I would love to try it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Try it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Try it?

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Sure! I think it became popular again in some S&M clubs in the Spire. I mean I'd need WAY better medical augments than I could afford.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure! I think it became popular again in some S&M clubs in the Spire. I mean I'd need WAY better medical augments than I could afford.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Do you want to know about my other "thing"? The singularity.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you want to know about my other "thing"? The singularity.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: And when that happens I know I need to get outside and see some fellow humans for a while.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And when that happens I know I need to get outside and see some fellow humans for a while.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Then when the wheel would turn it would mash up their limbs, so they were just a head with a mangled body wound around them in a circle.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then when the wheel would turn it would mash up their limbs, so they were just a head with a mangled body wound around them in a circle.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: So intelligent that we couldn't predict what they would do or think. Then the machines would harvest us or something.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So intelligent that we couldn't predict what they would do or think. Then the machines would harvest us or something.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: But we are!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But we are!

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Okay, we don't do that!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Okay, we don't do that!

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Hey, I'm listening!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, I'm listening!

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: We invented the singularity - and didn't even notice.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We invented the singularity - and didn't even notice.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: I don't think the super-intelligent Automata - if they really existed at all - really care about us. We just got left with the really dumb ones.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't think the super-intelligent Automata - if they really existed at all - really care about us. We just got left with the really dumb ones.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: I mean, we only think Automata would care about their creators because we do, but the point of the singularity was they DON'T think like us anymore.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean, we only think Automata would care about their creators because we do, but the point of the singularity was they DON'T think like us anymore.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Okay, I'm out of here. You can apologize later!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Okay, I'm out of here. You can apologize later!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm ok.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm ok.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are YOU ok?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are YOU ok?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm a fellow human.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm a fellow human.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The friend process?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The friend process?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Friendships are built on shared interests.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Friendships are built on shared interests.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Friendships are built on shared interests.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Friendships are built on shared interests.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Friendships are built on shared values.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Friendships are built on shared values.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Friendships are built on shared values.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Friendships are built on shared values.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Friendships are about advancing your own interests.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Friendships are about advancing your own interests.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Friendships are about advancing your own interests.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Friendships are about advancing your own interests.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What interests?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What interests?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Me too.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Me too.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I know exactly what I believe.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know exactly what I believe.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I know exactly what I believe.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I know exactly what I believe.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Good.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you want to talk about?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you want to talk about?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What do you want to talk about?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What do you want to talk about?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The breaking wheel?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The breaking wheel?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The singularity?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The singularity?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Harvest?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Harvest?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Dangerous Automata. I understand that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Dangerous Automata. I understand that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Most Automata are incompetent.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Most Automata are incompetent.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So what happened with this "singularity".

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So what happened with this "singularity".

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What about the "harvesting"?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What about the "harvesting"?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe they just haven't killed us YET?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe they just haven't killed us YET?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe they just haven't killed us YET?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe they just haven't killed us YET?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe they just don't care about us.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe they just don't care about us.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe they just don't care about us.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe they just don't care about us.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's a bit depressing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's a bit depressing.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not sure.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not sure.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What the Hell, Lois?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What the Hell, Lois?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Nice.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nice.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: On yourself, I hope!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: On yourself, I hope!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you mean with "happened"?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you mean with "happened"?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ava!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ava!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm still evaluating the test results.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm still evaluating the test results.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm still evaluating the test results.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm still evaluating the test results.
